newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Rain boosts pastures in NSW Australia - govt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Rain boosts pastures in NSW Australia - govt.

text.p: Widespread rain over much of the Australian state of New South Wales in late January continued excellent pastoral conditions in most areas, state Agriculture Minister Richard Amery said in a statement.
Despite this, rain missed large areas of the western division and drought had extended in these areas, he said.
The Monaro region in the southern highlands continued to miss any significant rainfall, he said.
The drought declared area of the state had increased to 23 percent in February from 17 percent in January, he said.
Water shortages for stock and domestic use were causing major concern in the Monaro and south-western areas, with stock numbers being reduced or agisted because of insufficient water, he said.
Excellent rain in summer cropping areas in the state's north had ensured a very positive harvest despite some damage in small areas, he said.
